--LINKDATAMINEOVERVIEW --LINKAPPMENUHIDE DECLARE @LAN VARCHAR(30) = '#LOGIN_LAN#'; DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = ( SELECT #LC.X3ERP#GETLANX3(@LAN) ); DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(10)='{0}'; DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(30)=N'%{1}%'; DECLARE @ZPLANNUM NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{2}%'; DECLARE @DYMB NVARCHAR(20)=N'{3}'; DECLARE @DYFS NVARCHAR(20)=N'{4}';
SELECT TOP 500 MFI.MFGNUM_0 工单编号 ,MFI.ITMREF_0 产品编码 --,ITM.ITMDES1_0 产品名称 ,ISNULL(B.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) 产品名称 ,ITM.ITMDES2_0 产品描述 ,R.ZPLANNUM_0 生产计划号 ,CAST(MFI.EXTQTY_0 AS REAL) 计划数量 ,CAST(MFI.CPLQTY_0 AS REAL) 已入数量 ,CAST(ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) AS REAL) 未提交数量 ,CAST(MFI.EXTQTY_0 - MFI.CPLQTY_0 - ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) AS REAL) 可入库数量 ,ITM.STU_0 单位 ,CASE WHEN ITF.DEFLOC_4 = '*' THEN '' ELSE ITF.DEFLOC_4 END 默认库位 ,CASE WHEN ITF.QUAFLG_0 = 1 THEN 'A' ELSE 'Q' END AS 存货状态 ,MFI.MFGFCY_0 生产地点 ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) > 0 THEN N'E02' WHEN MFI.EXTQTY_0 - MFI.CPLQTY_0 > 0 AND MFI.CPLQTY_0 > 0 THEN N'A02' ELSE 'C01' END AS LINKAPPRROW ,'' LINKROWIDCJM ,'' LINKROWIDDCM ,'' LINKROWIDDJM ,@DYMB LINKROWIDDYMB ,@DYFS LINKROWIDDYFS FROM MFGITM MFI INNER JOIN MFGHEAD H ON H.MFGNUM_0 = MFI.MFGNUM_0 INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.IDENT1_0 AS ITMREF , STRING_AGG(B.TEXTE_0, '') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B.ZONE_0) AS ITMDES FROM ATEXTRA B WHERE B.CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND B.LANGUE_0 = @LANX3 GROUP BY B.IDENT1_0 ) B ON B.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON ITF.STOFCY_0 = MFI.MFGFCY_0 AND ITF.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MFGNUM_0 ,ITMREF_0 ,SUM(UOMCPLQTY_0) UOMCPLQTY_0 FROM XWSMKI WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 GROUP BY MFGNUM_0 ,ITMREF_0) XWI ON XWI.MFGNUM_0 = MFI.MFGNUM_0 AND XWI.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN SORDER R ON R.SOHNUM_0 = MFI.VCRNUMORI_0 WHERE ( MFI.EXTQTY_0 - MFI.CPLQTY_0 ) > 0 AND H.MFGSTA_0 = 1 AND MFI.MFGFCY_0 = @FCY AND MFI.MFGNUM_0 LIKE @MFGNUM AND ISNULL(R.ZPLANNUM_0,'') LIKE @ZPLANNUM ORDER BY MFI.MFGNUM_0 DESC
